name: Shaxriyor Jabborov
summary: DevOps / Cloud Engineer and System Administrator with over three years of experience running production infrastructure on AWS and GCP. I build CI/CD pipelines, observability stacks and Linux-based environments that stay up: 99.9% uptime, deployments 50% faster and cloud spend down 20%. Based in Tashkent; open to on-site, hybrid and remote roles.

bullets: Built a centralized observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager), cutting incident response time by 60%.
Cut monthly AWS costs by 20% by optimizing EC2 and S3 usage and adopting Savings Plans.
Prevented production outages by finding Tomcat thread-exhaustion bottlenecks and adding automated recovery.
Designed a secure cloud attendance integration for Hikvision face-recognition devices over ISUP 5.0 (outbound TLS), removing inbound exposure at client sites.
Upgraded a legacy GitLab Omnibus installation to the latest stable release and automated database schema sync across dev, stage and prod with a Python CLI.
Led a zero-downtime migration of production AWS infrastructure to a new account and region, with full data integrity.
Reached 99.9% uptime with proactive monitoring, alerting and incident prevention.
Cut deployment time by 50% with Jenkins CI/CD automation and Docker-standardized environments.
Hardened IAM, segmented networks and enforced controlled access across AWS and GCP.
Secured $100K in Google Cloud credits (GFS Cloud Program 2024) and $10K in AWS Activate Portfolio credits; documented architecture and deployment workflows for onboarding.
Built responsive web interfaces with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and React, turning Figma designs into production-ready pages.
Worked with backend and DevOps teams, gaining early exposure to deployment workflows and version control.
